C1628.title: Digital Avatars Frequently Spark Celebrity Lookalike and Deepfake Fraud Scandals
C1628.summary: The report notes that as AI technology advances, the digital avatar sector is increasingly plagued by issues such as avatars resembling celebrities, 'resurrecting' the deceased, and using deepfake technology for fraud, raising widespread public concern.
